title: Here’s How to Watch UFC 330: Makhachev vs. Machado Garry Live Online for Free
summary: Live from Philadelphia on Aug. 15, you can watch the entire MMA event online for free.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

The UFC is headed to the “City of Brotherly Love” for UFC 330. Two top fighters will face off in the main event, as Russian Islam Makhachev (28-1-0) defends his welterweight title against Irish fighter Ian Machado Garry (17-1-0) on Saturday (Aug. 15).

UFC 330 takes place at Xfinity Mobile Arena in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, with a start time of 5:30 p.m. ET/2:30 p.m. PT. The main card begins at 9 p.m. ET/6 p.m. PT, with the main event starting around 11:30 p.m. ET/8:30 p.m. PT.

Watch UFC 330 with DirectV free trial

What Is Makhachev’s and Machado Garry’s Walkout Music for UFC 330?

Although the UFC has yet to announce each fighter’s walkout songs for UFC 330, both usually go out to the octagon to the same songs during their matches. Makhachev has walked out to “Dreams” by DJ Nariman, while Ian Machado Garry prefers to walk out to “Layla” by Derek and the Dominos.

How to Watch UFC 330 Live Online

OFFICIAL STREAM

Paramount+

$8.99

GET PARAMOUNT+

The Paramount+ Essential Plan , which gives you access to tons of TV shows and movies with limited commercials, increased a dollar to $8.99 per month (or $89.99 per year). The ad-free plan got a small price bump as well to $12.99 per month (or $129.99 per year), but it now includes Showtime, along with everything in the Essential Plan and access to your local CBS station.

After the free trial ends, your plan will automatically renew at the regular rate, but you can cancel any time.

NEW STREAMING DEAL

Paramount+ on Walmart+

Shoppers can receive access to Paramount+ included with any Walmart+ subscription , the retail giant announced last September. A Walmart+ subscription is $98 for the annual plan (about $8.17 per month) after the 30-day trial.

185+ CHANNELS

DirecTV

Get 5-Day Free Trial

Including a five-day free trial, the streaming service DirecTV comes with free access to Paramount+ with its “Premier” package , which goes for $129.99 for the first month of service ($169.99 per month afterward). It features more than 185 channels, as well as access to ESPN Unlimited, HBO Max, Disney+, Hulu and other streaming services, unlimited DVR storage and the ability to stream on three devices simultaneously. Once the five days are up you’ll be charged the subscription price based on what package you choose at checkout.
